portfolio.title: Selected Cases
portfolio.intro: Membership rules, clinical workflow redesign, and a human-AI loop in medical PACS.
portfolio.stage.title: System Cases
portfolio.stage.intro: Three complex-system case studies showing how I turn rules, workflows, and collaboration into executable product systems.
portfolio.item.1.title: Member automation and service continuity
portfolio.item.1.body: Membership, coupons, payments, and billing were disconnected, leaving frontline teams to improvise and finance to reconcile manually.
portfolio.item.1.reframe: I reorganized card, discount, payment, and reconciliation rules, then moved frequent member workflows into system automation.
portfolio.item.1.result: Rolled out across all clinics. On-site testing reduced a typical member upgrade from 4–5 minutes to about 1; finance estimated reconciliation moved from roughly 3 days to 1.
portfolio.item.2.title: Orthodontic screening and status management
portfolio.item.2.body: Orthodontic pre-management relied on review events and offline coordination, leaving screening, conclusions, and follow-up disconnected.
portfolio.item.2.reframe: I turned recommendation rules, re-screening logic, orthodontic status, and multi-role collaboration into one continuous system flow.
portfolio.item.2.result: All-clinic orthodontic sales conversion moved from roughly 30–40% in Feb–Apr 2025 to roughly 50–60% in Feb–Apr 2026.
portfolio.item.3.title: PACS interpretation and AI-assisted review
portfolio.item.3.body: Pure manual image reading lacked system traceability and quality control, making utilization and diagnostic behavior hard to track.
portfolio.item.3.reframe: I first turned image reading into a structured record flow, then built a human-AI loop around AI marks, doctor review, and feedback recovery.
portfolio.item.3.result: Backend records show 1.43 findings in June 2024 and 3.46 in June 2025. AI launched around November 2025, so the earlier change is not attributed to AI.
portfolio.item.1.cardDesc: Connect membership cards, coupons, charges, and billing for express checkout and compliance.
portfolio.item.2.cardDesc: Redesigned pedodontist-orthodontist workflow and built a state-machine tracking funnel.
portfolio.item.3.cardDesc: Structured image reading audit logs paired with human-AI loop data flywheel.
